title: linnet
description: The complete linnet software family: linnet, clinnet, linnet-py, and linnest. It provides half-edge graph data structures and algorithms for subgraphs, tensor networks, and Feynman diagrams.
notes: Linnet-authored source is available under the MIT License. Its default functionality does not require Symbolica; enabling the optional Symbolica feature requires a user-provided Symbolica license.
